text:
maya (partnerships): EmberCore submitted a model bundle and claims 'commercial redistribution allowed; open weights.' They provided a contributors CSV but no sigs. Need clarity on redistribution scope and export controls before any marketplace SKU or HW bundling.

sam (legal): First pass: ask for cryptographic proof of origin (sigstore/GPG), contributor CLAs, and a clear license breakdown: code, model weights, datasets. If any dataset is CC-BY-SA, redistribution could force derivative licensing; that's a blocker for downloads.

eric (hw-partner): For devices, we need explicit binary redistribution rights. Our usual ask: an addendum allowing distribution to authorized resellers and preloaded devices, plus a security contact. Revenue share matters too.

nina (product): Product preference: allow hosted API access quickly, gate downloads and partner bundles behind legal clearance and a short canary. We should require quantized artifacts and a compatibility matrix with runtime versions.

sig-check-bot: SVC_SCAN: no verified signatures found in submitted tarball. FLAGGED: provenance_missing (HIGH).

zara (marketplace): Marketplace listing options: "hosted-only", "partner-bundle (restricted)", "redistributable (downloads)". Until sigs + attestation are provided, mark as "hosted-only" and add badge: "Pending redistribution approval". Also need exact attribution text for listing.

maya (partnerships): Action items: (1) I will request signed release (sigstore or GPG), contributor CLAs, SBoM, dataset manifests, and export-origin statement (ETA 72h). (2) Sam to draft a short redistribution addendum and a template attestation (ETA 48h). (3) Eric to outline HW-bundle requirements and revenue-share terms. (4) Nina to prepare canary plan: limit traffic to 5% initially, telemetry enabled, auto-revert on legal flags.

sam (legal): Draft addendum snippet (very rough):

```
Provider grants Redwood a non-exclusive license to host the Model and, subject to Provider's written approval, to distribute compiled binaries to Redwood-authorized resellers and hardware partners. Any further redistribution requires Provider's prior written consent. Provider warrants it has the rights to grant these licenses and that the Model does not include materials that impose incompatible ShareAlike obligations.
```

eric (hw-partner): If Provider accepts HW carveout, we'll require certification steps: firmware integration test, package signing, and a vulnerability disclosure contact.

zara (marketplace): Marketing note: co-announcements need legal clearance + export check + 2-week review for copy. No joint blog until redistribution scope is final.

nina (product): Canary config example: `canary(percent=5, telemetry=true, auto_revert_on=takedown)` 4a1 I'll add it to the deployment doc.

maya (partnerships): Scheduling a 30-min sync with EmberCore + legal tomorrow 11:00 PT to walk through requirements. Please update this thread with templates and checklist links. :handshake:

sam (legal): I'll post the attestation template and a short FAQ on CC-BY/SA implications to the partnerships board after the sync.

zara (marketplace): Once we have signed tags and attestation, we can move to "partner-bundle (restricted)" for review; full redistributable downloads require CLA + explicit redistribution license.

maya (partnerships): Thanks all. tagging: @sam (legal) @eric (hw-partner) @zara (marketplace) 44d
